description: Bodies as Y documents, written by apps/web/tools/ydoc/vectors.ts from the editor's own binding (@tiptap/y-tiptap); the server's conversion (crates/collab) and the web app's tests read it. Do not edit by hand. field is the name of the XML fragment at the root of the Y document. An update is a whole Y document as a version 1 update in base64, and json is what an editor reads from it in the form that is stored (null for no body). documents: every accepted case of body-vectors.json with a body (not those with a build), by its name; json is that body as it comes back, which differs where the editor fills in an attribute (the start of an ordered list) or orders marks. readings: shared content no editor writes and every editor keeps, and how it is read. repairs: shared content that does not fit the schema; json is what is left when an editor has deleted what fails, from the bottom up. schema: the marks in the order the editor stores them, and the attributes of each mark and node with the value given to one that is left out (null: none).
